title: Shanghai Noon
tagline: Chopsticks meet six-shooters. Both bring food.
about: An imperial guard heads to 1880s Nevada to rescue a kidnapped princess, with a smooth-talking outlaw in tow.
cue: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy hit the saloon in Carson City.
faces: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy hit the saloon in Carson City.
“I came to rescue a princess, Roy. Now pass the noodles before you eat them all.” Chon Wang
Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with soy and black vinegar

Poster and stills: TMDB. Bill no. 2000. Talk of the town: Roy O'Bannon, the talky outlaw. Princess Pei Pei.
